result.topic_en: Case analysis of inequalities among the parameters a, b, c (with b > c) determining the signs of the quantities S, T and D, and when an integral in T or S is negative or positive, for the rotating fluid ellipsoid problem.
result.transcription:
$b > c$ , $a \leqq \frac{b-c}{2}$ , $S < 0$ $T > 0$.
Integral in $T$ immer negativ, denn $b \geqq 2a + c$
$D\,(c^2 - a^2) > 0$
also entweder [-...-] $c^2 > a^2$ ; $c^2 < \frac{a^2(b^2-4a^2)}{b^2-a^2}$
a) $c^2 < \frac{a^2(b^2-4a^2)}{b^2-a^2}$ $D < 0$ [-I[?] immer negativ, folglich $c^2 < a^2$-] Integral in $S$ positiv, wenn $c^2 < a^2$
$c^2 < \frac{a^2(b^2-4a^2)}{b^2-a^2}$ , $c \leqq b - 2a$
b) $a^2 < c^2$ $D > 0$
$a < c < b - 2a$
$ \; \; \; 2a < b$[?]
$\frac{4ab}{b-2a}$ $\; c^2$[?]
